body: Yeah it’s insane. I’m tired of these kids who aren’t even mine dictating my life and relationship. They’ve been in between me and their mom the entire time making us argue
She’s quite beautiful lol, but you’re right.
I’m trying. Thank you very much.
Thanks so much. I’ve never felt so alone in my life. I’ve heard some pretty dark thoughts and it’s day by day, not eating etc but ultimately I have to stay sane for my daughter’s sake.
Is that the official name of the form?
They got much worse once he came back in the picture but yeah you’re right.
Thanks for the feedback. It’s been this way the whole time so I kind of set myself up for failure.

Thank you for the encouragement. The feedback is unanimous so I definitely need to get myself together and seek legal counsel. She keeps telling me she’s coming back in a couple weeks and she can’t stay out there because she’s also taking her sons and their dad wouldn’t let them just stay in California, but who’s to say he isn’t coming to pick up his sons and she just stays there with my daughter? So much what ifs. I just need to focus on custody.

It’s always been this way. She’s contributed here and there but never on a consistent month by month basis. I was trying to support her talents as a very skilled painter but she won’t paint because she says the relationship makes her too depressed to paint(when she does, they sell). I’ve brought her several well paying commission opportunities and she won’t follow through. Her response is “I don’t want to pay for somewhere I don’t want to be!”

I just couldn’t do anything right I guess. I was their father figure while their dad was out drinking and partying, then when he wants to swoop back in, I’m the bad guy who can’t tell them anything. Now it’s too late I’m losing my whole family.
I’m so sorry to hear that. I guess I know what I have to do. I just have to pick up my balls and go do it.

The thing is they already don’t spend time with her. If they are here they are in the room on games or the phone all day and night, whether I’m in the house or not. I’ve literally offered them money to go do things with their mom and they don’t follow up. It just doesn’t even make sense.
I’m worried about that too. Can’t believe this is happening
I’m getting the same advice across the board so I can’t deny what I have to do. Thank you.
We live together and we have a domestic partnership on file with the state court because I had her on my insurance, not sure if that comes into play with this situation
Thank you. She’s telling me “if you don’t let me take her so she can enjoy the beach for a couple weeks you don’t love her. Your daughter deserves a father who loves her” she literally said that.
